# prime-autocomplete

prime-rs: AutoComplete component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/autocomplete) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-autocomplete) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/autocomplete.md)

AutoComplete: port of PrimeNG 21.1.10 `p-autocomplete`.

Input field with suggestions: when typing from `min_length` characters, `on_complete` is called after `delay`, the user
updates `suggestions`, and the options are shown in a panel inside the root. Options are `AutoCompleteOption` (groups
via `items` and `group = true`). The single-mode value is `RwSignal<String>`, the multiple-mode one (`multiple`, chips) is
`RwSignal<Vec<String>>`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_autocomplete::{AutoComplete, AutoCompleteOption};

let items = vec![AutoCompleteOption::new("Apple"), AutoCompleteOption::new("Banana")];
let value = RwSignal::new("Apple".to_owned());
let html = Owner::new().with(|| view! { <AutoComplete suggestions=items value=value /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-autocomplete-input") && html.contains("Apple") && !html.contains("p-autocomplete-overlay"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-autocomplete = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["autocomplete"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
